result.summary: Found 4 issues including a cut-off content card, truncated text, and layout inconsistencies affecting readability.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the edge of the screen, with its name truncated and delivery info hidden
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll container to properly clip/fade the edge card or add a visual indicator (like a partial peek with gradient fade) to signal scrollability

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccola' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' without ellipsis or proper text wrapping
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis truncation (...) or reduce font size to ensure full name fits within the card boundary

issues.description: Heart/favorite icon on the ramen bar image is white/outlined while the heart icon on the pizza image below is a solid dark circle - inconsistent icon styling across similar cards
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon style and background across all promotional/popular item cards for visual consistency

issues.description: The horizontally scrollable category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) shows a partially cut-off pill at the right edge with no visible label
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial visibility cue at the edge to clearly indicate more categories are scrollable
